original_test_intent: Benchmark every approved NVMe E1.S with the four specified fio profiles and compare per-drive bandwidth, IOPS and latency to customer SPEC without touching non-target data.
original_method: Inventory E1.S devices by serial/WWN/namespace/PCIe path; bind each to an empty or backed-up scratch target and pin fio/libaio; define runtime and customer thresholds for all profiles; baseline SMART/media/temperature/power; preserve logs; run profiles sequentially per allowlisted drive with hard stops; retain raw output and restore/verify targets.
manual_activity: Storage owner allowlists each disposable E1.S, provides SPEC/runtime and accepts write/endurance impact; operator verifies identity twice, backup/empty proof, cooling/OOB and recovery.
required_inputs: Empty/backed-up scratch target and restore plan
safety_requirements: Run one profile/drive at a time unless explicitly approved
Stop on data/media/PCIe/thermal/power anomaly; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Run four approved profiles sequentially per drive
engineer_actions: Own data recovery and drive disposition

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A version check does not perform the source benchmark and its unsafe SSH form is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Substitute each verified scratch target for `/dev/sdx`, freeze runtime and execute the four exact profiles one at a time with protected output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 2M sequential and 4k random read/write, direct/libaio, depth16, 16 jobs, time-based operation, all E1.S and 1500-minute allocation are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use generated per-drive job manifests bound to immutable device identities, serialized destructive phases and explicit per-profile thresholds plus health/integrity checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces placeholder target/runtime/spec with verified allowlists and adds data protection/monitoring/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Checking fio installation cannot satisfy any performance profile.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Writes are destructive and endurance/thermal intensive; device-name changes can target the wrong data.

project_override_considerations: Storage engineering must define raw versus filesystem targets, preconditioning/steady-state, runtime, repetition/statistics and per-model SPEC/tolerance.
expected_evidence: fio/kernel versions and per-drive identity map
Backup/empty/scratch proof and exact job manifest

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target E1.S fio performance; placeholders and missing SPEC are execution-input gaps rather than contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if any target identity/backup, runtime, SPEC, destructive scope, monitoring or recovery cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row381 Wistron-Storage-00072-V003: approve every E1.S serial/WWN/namespace/PCIe/UUID scratch target and backup/empty proof, raw-vs-filesystem policy, `<time>`, preconditioning/repeats, customer IOPS/BW/latency SPEC/tolerance for all four profiles, destructive-write authorization, health stops and recovery.

review_improvement: Retains every fio workload while making target selection immutable, performance numeric and destructive effects recoverable.
independent_technical_reasoning: `/dev/sdX` is unstable and four profiles include destructive writes, so target identity is part of correctness. Performance also varies with preconditioning, runtime and model; each drive/profile needs raw metrics and matched SPEC plus health evidence, not an installation check.
